entities.summary: The Amagi Line  is a Japanese railway line connecting Kiyama Station, Kiyama and Amagi Station, Asakura. This is the only railway operated by the third-sector railway company Amagi Railway . The company, and sometimes the line, are also called Amatetsu (甘鉄).
